title: pnr-node: a GPU-accelerated DREAMPlace/OpenROAD evaluator node for CHIA
description: Artifact of the A³ (Agentic Approaches to Architecture) Workshop at MICRO 2026 hackathon short paper "A GPU-Accelerated DREAMPlace/OpenROAD Evaluator Node for CHIA: Timing-Driven GPU Placement, Cached Multi-Backend Evaluation, and Noise-Aware Agentic Search". Contains the evaluator node, the Docker environment, the job files, and the results with the scripts that recompute every table and figure.
